name: spotify
description: Icon-only Spotify controls above the prompt (prev/play-pause/next/mute/like, AppleScript, no login) with a fullscreen sidebar for browsing/playing your playlists (Spotify Web API, one-time login).

clientId.title: Spotify Client ID
clientId.description: From a free app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard. Set its Redirect URI to exactly http://127.0.0.1:8907/callback. Only needed for the sidebar's like/playlist features — the band's play/pause/next/prev/mute work without it.
